name: Wave Fix
description: Fixes the wave gamemode angle being off by ~0.1 degree and less.

enabled.name: Enable Wave Fix
enabled.description: Correct regular and mini wave movement using anchored trajectory projection.

fixMomentum.name: Fix Momentum
fixMomentum.description: Also force wave y-velocity to match horizontal speed. May change exit velocity when going into other gamemodes.

visualizer.name: Show Visualizer
visualizer.description: Draw the ideal wave angle (green ray + text), vanilla physics angle (red ray + text), and vanilla inaccuracy (cyan text) from the player while the mod is active.

logging.name: Enable Debug Logging
logging.description: Log corrected wave movement and velocity values.

stateLogging.name: Enable State Change Logging
stateLogging.description: Log wave trail resets, slope state transitions, and teleport events.
